title: Phase 2：規則 54 在寬度除以 4 餘 2 或 3 的環上，暫態 (w−6)/2、(w−7)/2，週期 4（R2-C10 第二、三段）

R2-C10.proof: w ≡ 0 (mod 4): Lean proof for all w ≥ 4 (DISC-0010, rule54_mod4_zero). w ≡ 2, 3 (mod 4): paper + Lean proof for all w ≥ 6 / w ≥ 7 in this record (rule54_mod4_two, rule54_mod4_three); numeric check by two implementations with cell-by-cell cone and defect-ether check for w ≤ 1200. w ≡ 1 (mod 4): still only the finite Lean check 6 ≤ w ≤ 200 (DISC-0006). The candidate as a whole stays SUPPORTED_NOVELTY_UNCHECKED until w ≡ 1 is proven.

novelty.note: No new searches in this record. The ether and the defect where two ether domains meet are standard rule-54 particle language (Hanson–Crutchfield 1997 etc., not re-read). Folding a mirror-symmetric ring orbit onto a segment with reflecting ends is the technique of DISC-0009. The reused OEIS query is the mixed four-class sequence; restricted to w ≡ 2 or w ≡ 3 the transient is just the even numbers, so that query does not discriminate these cases. Not checked: arXiv, MathSciNet, Jen's cylindrical CA papers, Wolfram's finite-ring tables. PROVEN_KNOWN here means proven with known techniques, not claimed new.
